summary: One combatant: links to Health, carries an initiative stat and lists the actions it can use.
overview: A participant in a battle. It self-registers with the manager, holds the initiative that decides turn order, and lists which action assets it can use. Add a brain alongside it and it becomes AI-controlled; without one the manager waits for the player.
useCases: Party members and enemies in the same battle.
Giving an enemy a different action list without new code.
Deciding turn order from a stat rather than a fixed sequence.

params.tuning: Higher goes first, re-sorted each round.
What separates the two teams for targeting. Get it wrong and enemies heal each other correctly and you incorrectly.
Assets, so two enemies can share an action list or differ entirely with no code change.

gotchas.title: No brain means player-controlled
gotchas.body: That is how the manager tells them apart, so an AI enemy missing its brain stalls the battle waiting for input that never comes.
